mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_task_outbox (task_id, event_type, payload_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, 'PENDING', 0, null, now())
mapper.select: select outbox_id, task_id, event_type, payload_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, sent_time, create_time from ai_video_task_outbox where status = 'PENDING' and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= now()) order by outbox_id asc limit #{limit} for update
mapper.update: update ai_video_task_outbox set status = 'SENT', sent_time = now(), update_time = now() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'PENDING'
update ai_video_task_outbox set status = 'FAILED', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = now() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select count(1) from ai_video_task_outbox where status = 'PENDING'
select timestampdiff(second, min(create_time), now()) from ai_video_task_outbox where status = 'PENDING'
